info.title: NetClaw local HUD HTTP API
info.description: Source-derived HUD route inventory. Local loopback service; not an internet API. MCP uses JSON-RPC tools/list and tools/call, not REST/OpenAPI. Generic schemas are explicitly incomplete.

servers.description: Default UI proxy; operator ports may differ
